//: attw asks one question: do the TYPES resolve, under every module-resolution
mode a consumer might use? Two answers are configured rather than fixed,
excludeEntrypoints — ./styles.css and ./a11y.css are stylesheets. They have
no declarations because a stylesheet has no types, and attw reports that as
'Resolution failed'. That is attw answering a question these entry points
do not pose. Their existence IS verified: the tarball audit in ci.yml checks
both files ship, and the vite-app fixture imports styles.css for real.
profile esm-only — the package publishes ESM only, on purpose: React 19,
Vite library mode, `type: module`, one `import` condition. Under the default
strict profile attw warns that CJS consumers reach it by dynamic import
only, which is a description of the design rather than a defect. The
esm-only profile asserts exactly that intent, so a change that ACCIDENTALLY
made the package dual-format or broke ESM resolution still fails.
